Just had my daughter's wedding celebration at Landmark buffet restaurant on 26/11/21
The experience was beyond words.
All our guests compliment and enjoyed to the food very much.The foods presentation have improved tremendously.Credit must be given to Chef Bob and kitchen team for their anticipation to excel and improved from time to time the restaurant food delicasy and presentation.
During our busy moment entertaining our guests
Landmark's Manager Mr Ramesh really come in handy and doing his extra miles to ensure our wedding majlis is to it's utmost best presentation .
One instance I was having my quick dinner with my wife at the pool side and my daughter getting ready in her hotel room for 8 pm function called us saying to me she and hubby were hungry
Unexpected ly Ramesh came by and expressed his concerning the pengantin dinner …And offer his help to get his team to send food to them, just cc to him their room no. I was touch by this humble gesture.
His assistant Mr Sulaiman also rendered to his fullest assistance during the wedding occasion which I cannot resist to credit and mention him here.
As we are providing our own deco Ramesh team allows us to do our deco even at wee hours to have access to the reception hall in order to complete them in time. Again I am touch by this gesture.
There is this staff server Mr Ming.. he has improved a lot in his work performance as compared to my last visit to the restaurant as I mentioned in my previous reviews.
Keep it up Mr Ming ..this shows the landmark restaurant management really allows and gives chance to it's staffs to improve and excel in their work performance.
Through out the occasion me, my wife and family were fully satisfied patronizing our daughter's wedding at Landmark Restaurant.
We have 5 more children for our future wedding occasion. We will definitely approached Ramesh and use their services inshaAllah Ameen
To all Parents who are seeking place for wedding or any  other celebration venue . Look no further
Landmark have it..talk to Ramesh who is willing to listen and custom made to all your celebration needs.
Really we had good experiences and memories there.
So What are you waiting for?Regards

Venue was very cozy - although it was in a pretty weird layout (being a lounge converted into a wedding venue), it was spacious for the number of pax (~80pax). Intercontinental’s food never fails to disappoint although some dishes were not as hot when they arrived.Oct 2023YS Phua (Guest)Venue: 4Service: 5Food: 5Attended a wedding dinner of my relative in Jul 2023. The dinner is held in a small ballroom which is cosy for a small wedding dinner of up to 7 tables. Food was good as it was catered by the restaurant situated in the hotel but separately managed. Service was good and the tea ceremony, which was held at a separate venue on the second floor, was very well organized .Oct 2023YR (Guest)Venue: 5Service: 5Food: 5As a guest and helper to the bride, I enjoyed the wedding held at Intercontinental. It was an intimate solemnization outside Man Fu Yuan + dinner at the Library for ~60 people.The venue (the Library) was beautifully decorated with fairy lights, a square arch, and fresh flowers. The reception table was a little crowded, no space for receptionists to sit and direct people. You have to bring your own ang bao box. However, at the corner you can still make space for a photobooth. Note that the bathroom is one floor down and requires walking down the stairs, so it is not very accessible.The staff were very helpful. They helped to pour and serve the tea during tea ceremony. During the dinner, they helped us to make gin and tonic drinks with the bottle of gin we brought in. Most guests left around 10-ish, but we could sing karaoke until 11pm.The food was catered by Man Fu Yuan, and it was one of the most delicious wedding dinners I had in Singapore. I'm still dreaming of the crispy skinned chicken with toasted almonds to this day.Jul 2023Queenie (Couple)Venue: 5Service: 5My husband and I hosted our wedding at Intercontinental Singapore, and we are in awed by the fantastic team that helped us during our big day. Shout out to my Wedding Manager Stefanie who went above and beyond, Floor Manager Mugilan, and the rest of the team, Shang Jun & Xue Ling; they made sure to take care of everything seamlessly so that my husband and I could enjoy the process. I am super appreciative, and will highly recommend any couples to InterconSIN.FromGoogle Maps· Jun 2023Aaron Tan (Guest)Venue: 5Service: 5Food: 5Friend had a wedding at the Grand Ballroom here. I was a vegetarian this month, but I forgot to tell the groom in advance. I asked the restaurant if they could prepare vegetarian food. Unexpectedly, the waiter was very professional and served me a whole set of vegetarian food immediately. I was very happy.
The vegetarian fried dumplings in the cold dishes, the potato filling was seasoned perfectly, and the dipping sauce was amazing; the vegetarian pork belly was very well restored and very delicious; the vegetarian shrimp and stir-fried vegetarian dishes were ordinary, but the taste was not bad. The vegetarian sweet and sour pork was also well seasoned, and the fried rice and sweet soup at the end also went well.

If you want a beautiful and intimate wedding banquet, Sofitel Sensosa is a good choice!FromGoogle Maps· Mar 2025patricia121686 (Couple)Service: 3Went there for staycation to celebrate my very first Valentine’s Day as married couple with my wife. Called the frontdesk/operator to rectify and has been informed that she will get back but no follow-up from her since then. We have frequented Cliff (Valentine’s Dinner), LeBar (cocktail) and Kwee Zeen (breakfast and lunch) with a top-notch service and great dining experience. Facilities are well-maintained and standards are up to the star rating expectation. Overall, I would rate the dining experience as great with average check-in experience and would probablyt return for dining experience but not sure of staying in again..FromGoogle Maps· Feb 2025Lionel B (Couple)Service: 5Present for a wedding, the room is very beautiful, the outside access offers a beautiful view.FromGoogle Maps· Feb 2025Tomithy Too (Couple)Venue: 5Service: 5Food: 5A Memorable Wedding Banquet at Sofitel Sentosa - #NeverTooMuchJoy!Our wedding banquet at Sofitel Sentosa was a dream come true and we are grateful to the amazing team at Sofitel for making our wedding day incredibly memorable. Especially to Ms. Prabavathy who was our coordinator and contact person - She’s superbly detail-oriented, responsive and high-touch and it was her organization and management that made the planning a breeze and a joy to have. Our banquet manager, Mr Manjit, 2nd IC - Mr Farzea, and their team executed the banquet smoothly and with an exceptional level of service. We felt very taken care of and did not have to worry.The Straits Ballroom was an elegant venue for our wedding, with long floor length windows framed the lush greenery and picturesque sunset ocean view. We loved the blue and white floral theme decorations - “Mystique”, which really enhanced the garden decor aspects of the property. The bridal suite offered a good amount of space, comfort and elegance. The personalized touches and supportive room service crew made our stay extra special.The team is super professional and listened attentively to our preferences and needs and was willing to go the extra mile. In our case. It was drizzling slightly in the afternoon and the team has already set up the solemnization area indoors. However, as soon as the skies cleared up about 30 mins before our Solemnization time, the team has proactively reached out to check-in with us to asked if we would like to shift the 50 chair + arch set up back into the gardens, allowing us to say “I do” in the perfect post-drizzle solemnization sunset!The Chinese 8 course was expertly prepared and bursting with flavors. The Double-Boiled Mini Abalone with Ginseng, Chicken’s Cepes Mushroom (2nd dish), Steamed Fragrant Rice with Prawns, Scallop and Salted Egg Yolk wrapped in Lotus Leaf  (7th dish) and Green Tea Tiramisu with Lady Finger Biscuit (dessert dish) were gastronomical delight. Our guests were thoroughly impressed, and we received countless compliments on the delicious food! Ms. Prabavathy has proactively worked with us table organizations, special diets and last minute guest arrangements, which really took a lot of stress off this aspect of banquet planning.In conclusion, if you're looking for a wedding banquet venue that combines elegance, exceptional service, sumptuous dinner service in an off-city location, we would recommend Sofitel Sentosa. Our wedding day was an absolute blast, and thank you to the entire team!Yours truly

Especially to Ms. Prabavathy who was our coordinator and contact person - She’s superbly detail-oriented, responsive and high-touch and it was her organization and management that made the planning a breeze and a joy to have. Our banquet manager, Mr Manjit, 2nd IC - Mr Farzea, and their team executed the banquet smoothly and with an exceptional level of service. We felt very taken care of and did not have to worry.The Straits Ballroom was an elegant venue for our wedding, with long floor length windows framed the lush greenery and picturesque sunset ocean view. We loved the blue and white floral theme decorations - “Mystique”, which really enhanced the garden decor aspects of the property. The bridal suite offered a good amount of space, comfort and elegance. The personalized touches and supportive room service crew made our stay extra special.The team is super professional and listened attentively to our preferences and needs and was willing to go the extra mile. In our case. It was drizzling slightly in the afternoon and the team has already set up the solemnization area indoors. However, as soon as the skies cleared up about 30 mins before our Solemnization time, the team has proactively reached out to check-in with us to asked if we would like to shift the 50 chair + arch set up back into the gardens, allowing us to say “I do” in the perfect post-drizzle solemnization sunset!The Chinese 8 course was expertly prepared and bursting with flavors. The Double-Boiled Mini Abalone with Ginseng, Chicken’s Cepes Mushroom (2nd dish), Steamed Fragrant Rice with Prawns, Scallop and Salted Egg Yolk wrapped in Lotus Leaf  (7th dish) and Green Tea Tiramisu with Lady Finger Biscuit (dessert dish) were gastronomical delight. Our guests were thoroughly impressed, and we received countless compliments on the delicious food! Ms. Prabavathy has proactively worked with us table organizations, special diets and last minute guest arrangements, which really took a lot of stress off this aspect of banquet planning.In conclusion, if you're looking for a wedding banquet venue that combines elegance, exceptional service, sumptuous dinner service in an off-city location, we would recommend Sofitel Sentosa. Our wedding day was an absolute blast, and thank you to the entire team!Yours truly

I felt very well taken care of throughout the whole process from our first recce of the venue to the actual wedding day. The high standard of service and professionalism of the staff allowed me to fully trust them with my wedding preparations such that my overall experience with voco Orchard felt fuss- and stress- free.Venue: The location is so convenient, a < 10 min walk from Orchard MRT. Although we didn't have enough tables for the Ballroom, we managed to book the Panorama Room on the top floor, which has a nice panoramic view of Orchard Road and is quite a cosy setup. The decor options provided by the hotel were also lovely.Service: My compliments to Sunshine Garcia, our Sales Manager, and Xin Hui, our Banquet Manager on the day, for their friendliness and overall professionalism. Sunshine was always responsive and tried her very best to accommodate all of our requests. Xin Hui was pro-active and so helpful on the day, even helping to lift or rearrange my gown train on a few occasions. Her passion and dedication to the job shines through. Even the hotel front desk staff were also very helpful, in processing our down payments for the event.Food: The food received high praise from many of our guests -- not just the main (Chinese/fusion) menu, but even the Halal and Indian vegetarian meals! There are several options per course to choose from, and we really appreciated this flexibility. Some of the dishes were also quite unusual/had a modern or fusion spin, rather than being standard (and perhaps boring) Chinese wedding dishes. The chefs also acted well on our feedback from the food-tasting session (e.g., in reducing sweetness of certain dishes). We were also impressed that they were able to accommodate our rather unusual request of serving the gravies and starch separately from the dishes for one table which had guests on a low sugar diet.Hotel perks: To sweeten the deal, voco Orchard also throws in many attractive and very competitive perks including a night's stay in a (bridal) suite, an extra Deluxe room, rebates off the final bill, dining credit, and even minor details like a bottle of champagne and wedding cake sent to the room after.Thank you voco Orchard for an unforgettable wedding celebration!May 2025Taruto Singapore (Guest)Service: 4This hotel used to be Hilton located at the top of Orchard Road. Living up to voco’s reputation, this is the best service we have ever experienced in any hotel :)Our search for a wedding venue was short and sweet because of Anthony’s service and sincerity. He brought us around the ballrooms and answered our queries with utmost transparency and honesty. He provided valuable advice, given that he is well-experienced with weddings and helped us plan for a pleasant wedding experience.
We really liked that in the end, we were confident of voco’s ability and Anthony assured us that he would be there to help if there are any changes we needed.Leading up to the wedding, Anthony followed up with us thoroughly and ensured all our discussions were documented and taken care of. On multiple occasions, we were pleasantly surprised by the additional concessions provided by Anthony to make our wedding a more comfortable one. During the food tasting, we were thoroughly impressed by the quality and taste of food! Especially the flexibility in choosing each dish of the Starter platter!  This is a huge plus point as the variety made it so fun and interesting for our guests! They really enjoyed the chilli crab!With such great service, we decided to have a cosy dinner with our immediate families at Opus Bar & Grill the night before. As expected, we were greeted with spectacular service and wonderful food. We got the seafood platter, butcher platter as well as the steak under the excellent recommendation of Patricia. It was a very pleasant dinner that ended off sweetly with desserts from D9 too! It left everyone in a good mood and we were all ready for the wedding the next day.On the wedding day itself, everything went according to plan thanks to detailed planning from Alvin and Anthony who gave us so many pointers and advice. It was truly a wonderful experience not having to worry about the program, the cues, the AV etc because Alvin had everything settled and cared for. Our guests had such a pleasant experience with the service, especially on getting their glasses filled continuously.
Furthermore the team went above and beyond to ensure that my husband & I were able to have our favourite dishes (Orhnee & Eefu Noodles) by sending a portion up to the room after the event. It is probably rare to hear this but my husband and I did not feel especially tired after the wedding, and we can't help but thank Alvin and Anthony for all the excellent arrangements made.On the day of the check out, we also had the best breakfast service from Push. After a restful night rest, it was the perfect breakfast to end our stay in voco. We were so so reluctant to leave!Overall, a fantastic experience for my husband, our families and me. All of our friends and family loved the food and service the crew has provided. Jeremiah, our wedding coordinator, had responded promptly to our request throughout the hectic planning and had ensured that the actual wedding day went smoothly as planned. Service crew were very sincere and helpful to some of my older relatives. Thank you Wheeler's Estate crew for accommodating to our needs and making our wedding an enjoyable place for all our friends and family, we are very very grateful for that! Wheeler's Estate is a beautiful place and will always be a place where we will reminisce our friends and family's smile and laughter! Photos from: ivanseahphotographyFromGoogle Maps· Jul 2023Steph (Couple)Venue: 5Service: 5Food: 5Hi BTBs! 
I had my wedding on on Sunday night at Verandah & into the woods and we would love to share my experience!My coordinator was Jeremiah and though there were hiccups along the way, he was fast to respond to them. He also replies very promptly to our queries & helped to make suggestions along the way (during planning stage and on AD itself to ensure the flow is smooth). Jeremiah and his crew also helped to carry 3 of my elderly guests up since the restaurant is on the second floor and there is no lift. Rlly gratefully for their help! Sadly he’s leaving in Sept.There are two bridal rooms: one on the first floor which the bride can use to touch up and change for March in while there’s another bridal room within the restaurant itself on the second floor which can be used for tea ceremony. The second floor bridal room is much bigger and can be used to put your barangs and decor. Do not that there is no safe in either room but the second floor bridal room can be locked with a key.We had the 5course meal (added on lobster pasta) and a lot of the guests complimented the food! They really loved it! The service crew were also very lovely and prompt in topping up drinks to keep our guests filled :) our guests who had the vegetarian food were surprised and absolutely loved their food as well. They commented it was even better than Ritz Carlton (which served them cold and less tasty food)😅.We were worried about the live band that night and our worries were unnecessary. The live band couldn’t even be heard inside because of the laughter and chatter of the guests. I didn’t even realised there was a live band ongoing until I was leaving the venue LOLAmbience of the restaurant was really cozy and lovely for an intimate wedding reception which our guests and us appreciated!solemnisation and sparkles (end of reception) at into the woods was soooo beautiful! We were worried about the heat for the solemnisation but there were one huge ass fan to keep the guests cool. Surprisingly not as many mosquitoes as I expected! But as it’s outdoors, do expect some insects. Do prepare more kitchen lighters (>5) so that it’s easier to coordinate the guests and light up those sparkles!Overall, the feedbacks we have gotten from our guests were positive and we ourselves also had a pleasant and unforgettable experience 🥰 if anyone has any questions, do pm me to ask me more! Hope this will help in your planning🙆🏻‍♀️From Telegram · Jul 2023Yuying (Couple)Venue: 5Service: 5Food: 5Hi guys! Just had my wedding ytd at the sky deck and would like to share my experience! 
⁃ the coordinator Yan Ning was responsive, especially closer to AD. During AD. It’s good to appoint someone to coordinate with her on programme flow and drinks in case a top up is required. 
⁃ Fairylights need to be rented. The price varies depending on the vendors so it’s good to get in touch with a few to compare prices! 
⁃ We received many positive feedback about the food! 
⁃ It was a little warm but we told our guests to dress light. (At least there was no rain) 
⁃ The live band was a nice touch and our guests enjoyed it. We arranged the seating such that our friends who will enjoy the music and not mind the volume at the nearer half of the sky deck, and families/relatives on the other side so they won’t feel “disturbed” by the volume. It worked well for us! 
⁃ We didn’t have much to project and show our guests so the two TV screens worked for us.Overall is positive and we really like the ambience there. Hope this helps in your planning if you’re consider the sky deck.🙂From Telegram · Jun 2023Darren Yau (Darren & Jade Photography) (Guest)Venue: 5Service: 5We were captivated by the charm and rustic ambiance of Wheeler's Estate as we documented a solemnisation ceremony there recently! Photos from: ivanseahphotographyFromGoogle Maps· Jul 2023Steph (Couple)Venue: 5Service: 5Food: 5Hi BTBs! 
I had my wedding on on Sunday night at Verandah & into the woods and we would love to share my experience!My coordinator was Jeremiah and though there were hiccups along the way, he was fast to respond to them. He also replies very promptly to our queries & helped to make suggestions along the way (during planning stage and on AD itself to ensure the flow is smooth). Jeremiah and his crew also helped to carry 3 of my elderly guests up since the restaurant is on the second floor and there is no lift. Rlly gratefully for their help! Sadly he’s leaving in Sept.There are two bridal rooms: one on the first floor which the bride can use to touch up and change for March in while there’s another bridal room within the restaurant itself on the second floor which can be used for tea ceremony. The second floor bridal room is much bigger and can be used to put your barangs and decor. Do not that there is no safe in either room but the second floor bridal room can be locked with a key.We had the 5course meal (added on lobster pasta) and a lot of the guests complimented the food! They really loved it! The service crew were also very lovely and prompt in topping up drinks to keep our guests filled :) our guests who had the vegetarian food were surprised and absolutely loved their food as well. They commented it was even better than Ritz Carlton (which served them cold and less tasty food)😅.We were worried about the live band that night and our worries were unnecessary. The live band couldn’t even be heard inside because of the laughter and chatter of the guests. I didn’t even realised there was a live band ongoing until I was leaving the venue LOLAmbience of the restaurant was really cozy and lovely for an intimate wedding reception which our guests and us appreciated!solemnisation and sparkles (end of reception) at into the woods was soooo beautiful! We were worried about the heat for the solemnisation but there were one huge ass fan to keep the guests cool. Surprisingly not as many mosquitoes as I expected! But as it’s outdoors, do expect some insects. Do prepare more kitchen lighters (>5) so that it’s easier to coordinate the guests and light up those sparkles!Overall, the feedbacks we have gotten from our guests were positive and we ourselves also had a pleasant and unforgettable experience 🥰 if anyone has any questions, do pm me to ask me more! Kudos to the amazing service, tip top, i have not a single complain and thank you for making my wedding day the most memorable one for me. We are very happy with the service and would highly recommend!!FromGoogle Maps· Jun 2023Huzaifah Huz (Guest)Venue: 5Very good place to have weddingFromGoogle Maps· Jun 2023Madina Mel (Couple)Venue: 1Service: 1Food: 3We had our wedding at Bay Laurel and there are a few things that I would like to share. (Please take note that this feedback is purely based on my partner, families, guests, and my own experiences).Venue/Catering:The venue was really nice and had a cozy ambience for an intimate wedding. The decoration and seating arrangements were beautifully arranged with a lot of fresh flowers.The food was delicious too.Service and Staff Members:The staff and waiters were not so friendly and approachable (e.g., unfriendly/unhappy faces).The waiters were not attentive to the needs of the guests and communication among the staff can be improved too  (i.e. when we already communicated with one waiter, the other waiter asked why we didn't inform them).The staff were still seated and eating in the dining hall when our second wedding session was about to start. Our guests had already arrived and we needed to assign them to their seats. When one of our bridesmaids asked, they said we should register our guests first. However, after registering, aren't they supposed to go to their seats? Additionally, we were not made aware that staff were supposed to sit there to eat.Waiting time between courses and the order in which the food was served (ie. serving from front to back or back to front) could be improved. For e.g., Table 2 just received their food, while Table 6 was already done eating their food. It’s obvious that there’s a lack of manpower during the first session. The waiter even asked my guests to pass the plate of food to the person sitting beside them.Some of our families who stayed over till the 2nd session mentioned that when they asked for water, the staff rejected their requests. We were not aware that Bay Laurel was very strict on this, if we knew, we would’ve prepared some water for ourselves.Some of our guests who were supposed to be seated indoors did not manage to come. Hence, my mom decided to bring some of the guests seated outdoors to sit inside. As a courtesy, my mom decided to inform one of the staff just to let him know (even though my mom doesn't even have to do that). After she informed him, he told my mom that she cannot do that, she should follow the name list. But my question here is, what’s the issue? We paid for all the seats, so regardless of whether our guests were assigned to sit indoors or outdoors, it didn't matter. Furthermore, it was my bridesmaid who was in charge of registration and not one of their staff. So this did not make sense to us.Event Planner:Lastly, we were appointed to work with one of their Event Planners as we plan for our wedding. For the short period of time that we have worked and communicated with her, overall, it was an unpleasant experience. She was not very forthcoming and seemed unfriendly. We expected her to be more attentive and exude more excitement as we are first-time bride/groom who were very excited about our wedding. However, after our initial meet-up with her, it did bring our mood down a little bit. There were also instances during the wedding where the event planner was not happy that our guests arrived late (for the 2nd session), and said something along the lines of, “I don’t care, I’m going to serve the food”. It was unprofessional of her to say that in front of guests and our families.Before posting this, I have already left feedback to the person in charge. We hope that they can take our feedback and use it to improve their service. We wish them all the best.FromGoogle Maps· Jun 2023Jamberi Kamis (Guest)Venue: 4Go thee for Wedding Invitation. We are writing this review to share our experience so that other couples can make a fully informed decision before committing to 1-Host for their big day.Unequal and Unfair Wedding Package TermsWhen we signed our contract in April 2024, we were not informed of any upcoming promotions, despite asking explicitly about any upcoming events and being flexible with our wedding date. Just two months later, 1-Host introduced a 15th Anniversary Promotional Package, which offered vastly superior perks, including:Big Pan Seafood Paella live station$500++ open creditComplimentary wedding favorsCorkage waiver for 15 bottlesComplimentary usage of L1 indoor space for an after-party (which includes a waiver of a $1000++ venue fee and $2000 minimum spend)2D1N stay at the Fullerton Bay HotelNone of these were included in our package. Truthful vendors typically advise couples to keep an eye out for upcoming promotions, as it fosters goodwill and transparency. 1-Host, on the other hand, did not provide any such guidance, leaving us to unknowingly lock in an inferior deal just before a major promotion.What’s worse, we have friends who booked outside this promotion and still managed to negotiate for these perks—something 1-Host repeatedly told us was not possible. When we told them about this, they wanted us to throw the other salesperson under the bus by revealing who he/she was while simultaneously telling us that “no exception will be made” for us. As you can see, customer service stops at the point you put down your deposit.Poor Customer Service & Take-It-or-Leave-It AttitudeWhen we raised our concerns to 1-Host and attempted to negotiate a fair resolution, we faced delays, dismissiveness, and a complete unwillingness to engage in a reasonable discussion.They took an average of two weeks to respond to each email or whatsapp message.After a single phone call, they disappeared for three weeks, only to return with a rigid, take-it-or-leave-it offer. Just two months later, 1-Host introduced a 15th Anniversary Promotional Package, which offered vastly superior perks, including:Big Pan Seafood Paella live station$500++ open creditComplimentary wedding favorsCorkage waiver for 15 bottlesComplimentary usage of L1 indoor space for an after-party (which includes a waiver of a $1000++ venue fee and $2000 minimum spend)2D1N stay at the Fullerton Bay HotelNone of these were included in our package. Truthful vendors typically advise couples to keep an eye out for upcoming promotions, as it fosters goodwill and transparency. 1-Host, on the other hand, did not provide any such guidance, leaving us to unknowingly lock in an inferior deal just before a major promotion.What’s worse, we have friends who booked outside this promotion and still managed to negotiate for these perks—something 1-Host repeatedly told us was not possible. Alvin Chua, a senior manager, told us flatly: "If whatand I have tried so hard to get and offer does not make any difference and is still by far a cry from the package you were referring to, then perhaps we can revert back to your original package."When we requested a simple and cost-free adjustment (converting part of our corkage waiver into F&B credits), we were denied and even told that the Compliance Team wanted to revoke the minor concessions they gave: "they wanted to revoke whateverand I have offered already"This was a clear threat to revoke previous offers simply because we asked for a minor and reasonable adjustment. Instead of showing flexibility or goodwill, we were met with pressure tactics and an unwillingness to engage in a fair conversation.Lack of Transparency & Commitment to Customer SatisfactionWe turned to Joseph Ong, the founder of 1-Host, for a fair resolution. While he initially promised to look into the matter, his final response simply passed everything back to the team that had already dismissed our concerns. After months of waiting and back-and-forth discussions, the outcome was exactly the same as when we first raised the issue—if not worse, since Alvin Chua later told us that even their small concession was at risk of being revoked.Based on our experience, we cannot recommend 1-Host to other couples looking for a trustworthy, transparent, and customer-focused wedding venue. We engaged the restaurant a year ago and have been planning our wedding together with the restaurant manager, Ms Shirley Eng. Shirley has been very reliable and accommodating to our requests, definitely someone you can trust to feel at ease on your big day! From the moment we started planning, the team was professional, attentive, and accommodating to our needs. Initially, our coordinator was Evonne, she was professional, prompt and very hospitable.Venue & AmbienceThe hotel exudes elegance with its blend of Thai-inspired decor and modern luxury. The ballroom was spacious, well-maintained, and beautifully set up according to our theme. Although we only had 100++ guests, we had the entire ballroom (3 combined into 1) which was very spacious for the guests, except that there were moments when it’s quiet, it really gets quiet. But it was necessary because we needed the screens to show videos as our deco is blocked. Nonetheless, very spacious.The Warmest Service We Could Ask ForWhat truly sets Dusit Thani apart is its people. From the start, Akash & Shadman (if spelling error, pls pardon), treated us with such kindness and dedication, ensuring that every detail was thoughtfully handled. They were incredibly patient, proactive, and always had a reassuring smile, which made the entire planning process stress-free. In terms of our big bags, security, we were assured.Most importantly, we met Chester who made our Dusit experience INCREDIBLE.  His attentiveness, patience, and reassuring presence made the entire planning process seamless and stress-free. He is in charge of reception and accommodation, and no detail was too small for him, and no request was ever too much—he truly went above and beyond to make sure our families were well taken care of. Thank you, Chester!Besides the hospitality of the hotel, I would like to bring your attention to the sales and events team in Dusit. We were a little disappointed with our coordinator who was new, given that it changed from Evonne to someone else. From someone who was very prompt with replies and gave personalized service, we could see the disparity in service. However, we understand and are grateful that everyone did their part to make our day special.Also, we had DIY deco where they helped to tear down and we did not loose any items as it was kept securely in the bridal gallery. This is a shoutout to Prabhu and his banquet team. Most of all, they were extremely accommodating.Food That Left a Lasting ImpressionFood was a big deal for us, and Dusit Thani absolutely delivered! Our guests couldn’t stop raving about how delicious and well-prepared everything was. The variety, presentation, and flavors were impeccable. We had international cuisine with Asian flavours, and everyone enjoyed the Dukkah Lamb the most.A Home Away From HomeOur stay at Dusit Thani was well-fitted into our theme, aviation. Our bridal suite was absolutely stunning with planes flying in every few minutes as the bride had her makeover etc, the best view ever!!!Thank you to everyone for making it such a memorable day for us.Love, Renu & CharhrenFromGoogle Maps· Feb 2025Marcus Xavier (Couple)Service: 5Amazing room, spent our wedding night here, staff are really friendly and welcoming. Rooms are very clean and nice. We look forward to coming back againFromGoogle Maps· Feb 2025Jennifer B. (Couple)Venue: 5Food: 5We held our intimate wedding lunch here. From the planning stage to the actual day, Gabriel, Evonne and the Dusit Thani team were very professional and accommodating.All our guests loved the banquet food (International Food)! And the venue is perfect for the celebration we wanted. Dzakkir of the banquet team was very attentive and helpful all through out. We are really pleased and glad that we chose Dusit Thani for our special day, thank you!FromGoogle Maps· Feb 2024Danielle Lim (Couple)Venue: 4Service: 5Food: 5I held my wedding here on June 25th & it was absolutely worth it. Let’s start with the ballroom, it was decorated beautifully and it looked new and not worn out like other hotels we initially scouted. There was even a bridal suite nearby on the same level for us to get ready in. Even though the air con was down that day, the hotel staff promptly provided a fan inside for us. Service wise the staff were all so professional and friendly. Shout out to Evonne, Sheik, Thinesh; you guys were absolutely wonderful & made us as guests feel very comfortable. The room we had was also lovely, the bed was super comfortable, hard enough for us and the pillows were good too. Water pressure in the shower was good and the toilet amenities were very good as well. The food was the winner for us. All our guests told us the wedding banquet food was one of the best they had for weddings. When we had the hotel buffet breakfast the next day, we were blown away by the selection and how yummy the food was. I’m super particular about my scrambled eggs & the chef did it perfectly runny, the way I personally like it. They even had congee. Sooo warm and comforting for the stomach after a long wedding day. No regrets holding our wedding here. Thank you Dusit!FromGoogle Maps· Jul 2023san cheow ho (Guest)Venue: 1Service: 2I was at a wedding dinner on Sat.

$148-$168++/paxEvent HallRestaurantChineseFusionWesternAll ReviewsCoupleGuest​​Jon Yi Hoo (Couple)Service: 5Our wedding manager, Tan Yan Hui, has been super friendly right from the beginning when we met. We felt very welcomed right from the start and comfortable and decided to go with Westin to have our wedding.
Along the way, whenever we needed advice/ help with the wedding day flow, we will check with Yan Hui and she was always very happy and friendly to give us some suggestions/ ideas, although for some of them she was not obliged to answer. She responded very quickly and almost felt like a wedding planner!
We are really thankful to have Yan Hui be so helpful, and also helped us ease some nerves. During the site visit a few weeks before the wedding, our bridal party went down together and they were really impressed at how Yan Hui was able to run through the details and programme flow in details, and that she was so approachable and made us all feel at ease!The wedding lunch banquet went smoothly all thanks to Steve Ang, who was a great banquet manager, and with the help of his team. He was able to look at the overall flow of the program (which started from solemnisation, to tea ceremony, then the banquet lunch itself) and also anticipate what were things to prepare for in advance. On top of that, he also calmed us down when it was close to start time for our wedding. He was constantly checking in with guests to ensure food served and service were up to standards, and also checking with the kitchen and chef. Before marching into the venue, he also gave us a quick pep-talk and how we should pace our walk together, and how we can hold the wedding dress and enjoy the experience. That was really very helpful to calm us down.
None of our guests told us any complaints in terms of service, food and experience. Instead, they were really impressed by how he was able to handle the whole banquet so well, and still be smiley and friendly!Aside from the delicious food served during the wedding, we truly believe that the service by Yan Hui and Steve really improved the experience both ourselves and our guests had during the wedding.FromGoogle Maps· Mar 2025William K (Couple)Service: 5This is information when staying at the end of 2024.A total of 4 people, 2 adults and 2 elementary school children, stayed in 2 double rooms.When making a reservation, go to Marriott's official website and find that there is no difference in price or required points whether you are making a reservation for 2 adults or 4 people including children. My family made a reservation for 4 people.Children under the age of 12 are not allowed inside the club lounge, but they can use the children's room next door or outside by the pool. There was no additional charge at that time.
The cocktail hour meals are of sufficient quality and quantity, and can be substituted for dinner during your stay. There is a Lao Pasa nearby, but I was so full from the lounge meals that I couldn't afford to go there.Also, as long as two adults ordered breakfast (platinum benefits are also accepted), two children were free as a Marriott member benefit.The children played in the infinity pool with a beautiful view for a long time.In summary, it was the best hotel for our family. If you are a Marriott Platinum member and are traveling with children under the age of 12, I think the cost performance is quite good.I wrote it here because there wasn't much information on the web.
I hope this will be helpful to you.FromGoogle Maps· Feb 2025Benjamin Ong (Guest)Venue: 5Service: 5Food: 5The wedding dinner in the ballroom was very grand served by dedicated staff all round.
The dishes were delicious.FromGoogle Maps· Jul 2023Casper Yap (Couple)Venue: 5Cosy place to hold wedding.FromGoogle Maps· Dec 2020Ma-ku Gan (Guest)Service: 5Food: 5Gone there for a wedding dinner only. Food and service is excellent.FromGoogle Maps· Mar 2019Alvin Q (wanderdreams) (Guest)Venue: 5Service: 5Food: 5Attended a wedding dinner. Have a awesome view in the 32nd floor. venue_category: VenuesVendorsMalay WeddingsPrice ListsPromotionsAboutWrite reviewMount Faber PeakEvent HallRestaurantChineseFusionWestern109 Mount Faber RoadCall·Email·WebsiteThe Ultimate Hilltop Wedding DestinationCreate blissful memories that will last a lifetime with a romantic hilltop wedding at Mount Faber Peak — one of Singapore’s most scenic and versatile wedding venues. Set against panoramic city and harbour views, our spaces blend natural beauty with elegant design for a celebration that feels both intimate and grand.Choose from a Ballroom with a View (200 pax), the crystalline Angsana Glasshouse (70 pax), the alfresco charm of Arbora (100 pax), or the sunset magic of Dusk & The Mirabilis Bar (120 pax). Whether you’re hosting a lavish dinner or an intimate solemnisation, your once-in-a-lifetime celebration truly reaches new heights here.Contact VenueDownload Wedding Brochures:Mount Faber Peak Wedding Kit (2025).pdfCapacity30-200 pax2025 PricingLunch: From $148++/paxDinner: From $168++/paxReview SummaryExceptional Team & Service: Reviewers consistently praised coordinators like Mae, Tina, Gwendolene, and banquet managers Jeffrey and Martin for being attentive, flexible, and calm under pressure, ensuring every wedding ran smoothly.Breathtaking Hilltop Setting: Couples and guests were wowed by the stunning views of the harbour, sea, and lush greenery, with many calling it the perfect romantic backdrop for both solemnisation and banquets.Delicious Food: The 8-course Chinese dinner and custom menus received glowing compliments for freshness, flavour, and presentation, with guests raving about dishes like the cod fish and praising the chef’s willingness to accommodate requests.19 couple reviewsVenue: 4.8 ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️Service: 4.7 ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️Food: 5 ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️6 guest reviewsVenue: 5 ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️Service: 4.5 ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️Food: 4.2 ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️Featured ReviewsAll ReviewsCoupleGuest​​Purnima Balraju (Couple)Service: 5Food: 5My husband and I did our wedding at Faber Peak last week. Jeffrey, the banquet manager is exceptional. We had some last minute additions which he managed to accommodate and everyone in the family had a good time. The food was delicious. During the tasting we had some tweaks and the chef added them in. Honestly, our family kept coming up to us to tell us how much they enjoyed the food. Thinking of planning a wedding? The MFLG team is reliable, accommodating and pleasant to work with.FromGoogle Maps· Oct 2025Pan Wei & Xin Ge (Couple)Venue: 5Service: 5Our guests were FULL OF COMPLIMENTS, and we couldn’t have asked for a better experience. It really was the PERFECT BACKDROP for our special day, and we felt so WELL TAKEN CARE OF from start to finish.FromVendor Testimonials· Aug 2025Avery & Samantha (Couple)Venue: 5Service: 5Food: 5Wedding planning with Mount Faber Peak was EASY AND STRESS-FREE. The team was accommodating to our requests. Hats off to the chef for delivering QUALITY FOOD that wowed our guests! Nizam was our star supporter, keeping calm and providing solutions during the event. He prevented potential disasters and ENSURED A SMOOTH EXPERIENCE. We'd definitely recommend Mount Faber Peak to friends and family for their wedding.FromVendor Testimonials· May 2025Kelvin & Faeryn (Couple)Venue: 5Service: 5Thank you so much for your kind wishes and for taking such great care of us on our wedding day! We truly had a WONDERFUL EXPERIENCE at Faber Peak, from planning to the banquet — everything went smoothly and beautifully, and the TEAM WAS FANTASTIC throughout.FromVendor Testimonials· May 2025Audrey Teh (Couple)Venue: 5Service: 5Food: 5We had our wedding at Mount Faber Peak, and it was absolutely beautiful and so memorable! The venue was stunning 🌸, with such a romantic vibe that made the whole day feel magical.Big shoutout to Tina, our coordinator, who was amazing throughout. She replied super quickly, answered every question we had with so much detail, and made the planning process so smooth. Jeffrey, the banquet manager, was also incredible—he gave us great advice and went the extra mile to make sure everything ran perfectly on the day.Our guests loved the food 🍽️ and everything went so smoothly—it truly was the best day ever! Highly recommend Mount Faber Peak for anyone planning a special day. ✨📸: @Inspireworkz_weddingFromGoogle Maps· Dec 2024Vina Vina (Couple)Venue: 5Service: 5Food: 5We held our wedding banquet at the ballroom at Mount Faber Peak on 28 September 2024, and it was an unforgettable experience.We first discovered this venue at a wedding fair. As an outdoorsy person and nature lover, I immediately fell in love with the scenic beauty surrounding the venue, and my husband loved it too.At the fair, we met Dave, who impressed us with his professionalism from our first meeting, through the booking process, menu tasting, and right up to the big day. He was incredibly responsive, addressing all our inquiries and concerns promptly, which gave us a lot of peace of mind throughout the planning process.One of the unique highlights of the venue is the cable car ride for wedding guests. Our guests, especially those from overseas, were thrilled with the adorable Hello Kitty cable cars—it added such a memorable touch to the celebration!Our banquet manager, Jeffrey, was equally amazing. We met him during the venue viewing and food tasting and were delighted to have him manage our banquet on the day. He was kind, professional, and ensured everything ran smoothly so we could relax and enjoy the moment.We highly recommend Mount Faber Peak as a wedding venue. The breathtaking scenery, scenic (and super cute) cable car rides, and professional team make it a standout location.The food was also fantastic! She was accommodating, understanding, and always one step ahead in making sure everything ran smoothly. She handled all our requests with ease, even helping us navigate logistical concerns like bank limits. Most impressively, she managed my parents so well that they were completely at ease throughout the event—something that meant a lot to me. Her dedication and professionalism made our wedding stress-free, and I am incredibly grateful for her support.The entire banquet team was outstanding. From the full-time staff to the part-timers, everyone was highly professional and attentive. They served our guests impeccably, and some even helped me with my dress without me having to ask. It’s rare to see such proactive service, and it made all the difference.Moe, the hotel’s operations manager, joined in later and ensured that food and drinks were served promptly, keeping our guests happy throughout the night. Speaking of food, almost every guest complimented how delicious it was—truly 5-star quality!Our hotel stay was just as impressive. In-room dining was lightning fast, and the food was so good that my husband wanted to reorder the pasta he had just eaten! The housekeeping team also went above and beyond. Despite the post-wedding mess, our room was spotless, towels/ dental kits/ soap were all replenished and the cleaner even took the time to teach my mum how to use the coffee machine before making her a cup of coffee himself. That small gesture was incredibly heartwarming.From the wedding to our stay, Marriott Tang Plaza exceeded all expectations. If you’re looking for a wedding venue with top-tier service, amazing food, and an exceptional banquet team, look no further!FromGoogle Maps· Mar 2025Jeffrey Williams (Couple)Service: 5The rooms appeared to have been refurbished from my last visit.  They were very clean, comfortable and spacious.  Probably more spacious because of the octagon style of the hotel, the rooms were more spread out with more room to maneuver around towards the window area..  Dined in the buffet, expansive offerings, delicious and value for money.  The rare beef might have been the best I remember in any buffet, to include the Shangri La.   And, the seafood was varied as well, and fresh.
But the staff in the executive lounge were really shined and worked as an team, supporting each other through the evening.   The lounge offerings were a very good assortment of food, from fresh fruit, hot dishes, horderves and deserts.  A good assortment of beer (Tiger and Heineken on draft), wine and varied spirits. But the real beauty of this lounge is the service!I have stayed in Marriott, JW Marriott, Hilton and Ritz Carlton lounges over the years. While Ritz Carlton execujtive level staff are well trained, I can't remember a service staff team of waiters and waitresses that were as professionally focused and efficient as an entire team, in getting drinks for the lounge guests or clearing tables for new visitors to sit down.  They were as good as the best I have seen, and better than most.   Obviously they are managed well, and appear to be happy in their duties.  They are "Top Shelf" and would be a nice training environment for potential new hires.  A stand out was Yusuff Asyraff who appeared to hold some managerial role.  He worked as hard as all the other team staff and greeted the guests in a cordial and welcoming manner.  He is a "Keeper" for Marriott.

I received an upgrade to a suite but on the 2nd day.  The suite is sweet!  Being Platinum Elite has great privileges when available.  The breakfast in the Marriott Cafe is scrumptious.  They have food from all over the world.  Checkout from the hotel was seemless: just dropped the room key card in a box & left.  This hotel is in a perfect location.  You can easily get on a subway directly below this hotel or on many buses right outside that take you to many attractions, all without stepping into the rain.  There is a direct bus to the airport right outside, for example.  Direct buses to many attractions right outside.  I know it may be silly to take buses & subways for many folk, but I actually find it part of my sight seeing to watch the locals go about their daily commutes.  It is fun. Unfortunately, the planning phase wasn’t so smooth. The disappointing part of the planning phase was that, it was a clash between the client’s wants vs what the planner thinks is best for the couple, hence the 3 star. As a bride, of course I would want to feel special on my day and likewise, I would love the same for my family and friends. One of the issue was that the management initially told us that the basic things, such as the table's decoration and center pieces, would not be provided and we would have to purchase them ourselves as it was deemed ‘not important’. A Wedding only happens once in a lifetime. It involves a lot of time, emotions and money. My wife and I had stayed at The Barracks Hotel for our wedding reception. We were very impressed by the top-notch service both at the reception and during our hotel stay. We would highly recommend any couple to have their wedding reception there. Manju, the hotel event specialist did an amazing job coordinating our wedding. Planning a wedding during the pandemic wasn’t easy but Manju was able to support and guide us along the way. She was very efficient in updating us about the guidelines and gave really good advice. We were able to enjoy the planning process partly because we had such a caring and understanding event specialist helping us out every step of the way. Appreciate that he almost replies to us almost instantly nearing to the date of our wedding - we really appreciate the promptness! Chris often listened to our ideas & gave constructive inputs and advice along the way. He was also supportive during our AV testing/rehearsal where he actively involved himself in helping to mitigate IT issues & even staging our walk-ins - which was really impressive even to our bridal team (some who have wedding experiences at other hotels themselves)!Dave - our banquet manager was involved in tea ceremony and the wedding lunch, and his performance exceeded our expectations! He was polite, reliable, attentive to details, made arrangements to cater to our guests with dietary restrictions, prioritized our guests and made them feel welcomed. (many praises from our guests about the level of service provided by the team) Although we were running behind schedule, he has managed the situation perfectly to allow us to finish the event on time. We felt at ease with him running the ground throughout the event!Aunty Hui Fang - one of the service staff whom assisted in tea ceremony and wedding lunch, has a kind demeanor (and a motherly vibe) and keeps her smile throughout the day. She guided us and our bridesmaid patiently on the tea ceremony process and assured us that we are in good hands! During the wedding lunch, she was very prompt in her service at our tables and even helped my wife with her dress when standing/sitting down to make her feel comfortable. Our family members that were served by her also praised her for being prompt and professional.Overall, we had a more than pleasant experience with our wedding lunch at Conrad Centennial. Our guests have nothing but praises for the professional service staff, the delicious food menu, and the beautiful and spacious bridal suite. Thank you for creating such memories for us and our guests. 🥰From: George & FeliciaFromGoogle Maps· Feb 2025L J (Couple)Service: 5It was so nice and clean and the breakfast was so delicious. I was a Marriott elite member but late checkout was not allowed. It was inconvenient that I couldn't use the drink credit after checkout. Even if I could only use it on the day of checkout, it would have been nice to have a cup of coffee when I got my luggage and leave, but they said no. Does this make a big difference???? The nasi lemak and gelato ice cream for breakfast (not cheap, but high-quality) were so delicious. The staff was friendly, the amenities were pretty, and there were many towels provided. I didn't use it, but it was nice that I could shower at the 4th floor pool after checkout.FromGoogle Maps· Feb 2025Bernard Quek (Couple)Venue: 1Service: 1Wedding Coordinator
Throughout the planning process, we had three wedding coordinators—Chris, Connie, and finally Clarabelle. Chris, the initial coordinator, failed to deliver on promises, such as sending invoices and completing the soft booking by the agreed deadline. He then went on leave and became unresponsive for over a month before being replaced. Connie, who took over, later resigned, passing the portfolio to Clarabelle just weeks before the wedding.The experience was frustrating due to repeated miscommunication and unresponsiveness. Chris had initially promised no cleaning fees for burst balloons (as long as confetti wasn’t used), but this was overturned by Clarabelle (communicated with management), forcing us to pay additional fees.A consistent issue across all coordinators was their lack of responsiveness. They would set deadlines in writing but fail to follow up or provide updates. Multiple follow-ups were ignored, causing unnecessary stress. While Clarabelle eventually did a decent job after meeting face-to-face, this repeated pattern of poor communication and mismanagement impacted our experience significantly. If they needed more time, they could have communicated that instead of leaving us in the dark.Banquet Management
Dave, the banquet manager, was professional and patient, but Eddie, the director, was rude and unprofessional. Eddie shouted at staff before the banquet over space issues. The vendor stylist had requested a two-meter aisle, but Eddie failed to account for the extra space needed for chairs. He initially refused to adjust (requested by the vendor and banquet manager) until I stepped in to justify, and even then, his hostility and poor attitude reflected badly on the hotel. Such behavior is unacceptable for someone in a leadership position.When I raised the issue, Eddie initially refused to adjust and only complied after I intervened. However, his attitude remained hostile, and he vented his frustration on the staff, creating an unprofessional and tense atmosphere. Such behavior is appalling for someone in a leadership role, and I strongly recommend Eddie be placed on a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) to address his attitude, communication, and ability to manage situations effectively.Bridal Suite Stay
The bridal suite was disappointing. One power outlet in the bedroom was not working, leaving us reliant on a single outlet near the bed. The living room had only one set of outlets located in the corner of the table—insufficient for a suite of this size. Additionally, the outlets were unstable, frequently turning on and off, making it difficult to charge devices reliably.I strongly recommend future couples bring several portable chargers and ensure they are fully charged beforehand, as it is nearly impossible to use devices comfortably while charging in the bridal suite. Adding to the disappointment, the suite lacked a bidet, which is a basic amenity and should be standard in a five-star hotel.Massage Experience
The massage at Essence Vale was poor. The masseuse, Sue, repeatedly caused discomfort by massaging my bones despite my feedback. When I raised concerns, she laughed and dismissed them. The spa is severely understaffed, with only two masseuses, neither of whom seemed properly trained to provide a professional experience.I ended the session early out of frustration and received only a 10% discount as compensation. The dismissive attitude from the staff made the experience worse. If you’re seeking a real massage, I strongly recommend visiting a real massage parlor rather than this hotel spa.Overall
While Dave was a bright spot, the unprofessional behavior of Eddie, poor communication from coordinators, subpar bridal suite amenities, and disappointing spa experience made this far below expectations for a five-star hotel. I cannot recommend Conrad Centennial for weddings or massage services.From Telegram · Nov 2024J (Couple)Venue: 4Service: 1Hi ladies, I’ve had my wedding on jan 2024. Throughout the planning process, we had three wedding coordinators—Chris, Connie, and finally Clarabelle. Chris, the initial coordinator, failed to deliver on promises, such as sending invoices and completing the soft booking by the agreed deadline. He then went on leave and became unresponsive for over a month before being replaced. Connie, who took over, later resigned, passing the portfolio to Clarabelle just weeks before the wedding.The experience was frustrating due to repeated miscommunication and unresponsiveness. Chris had initially promised no cleaning fees for burst balloons (as long as confetti wasn’t used), but this was overturned by Clarabelle (communicated with management), forcing us to pay additional fees.A consistent issue across all coordinators was their lack of responsiveness. They would set deadlines in writing but fail to follow up or provide updates. Multiple follow-ups were ignored, causing unnecessary stress. While Clarabelle eventually did a decent job after meeting face-to-face, this repeated pattern of poor communication and mismanagement impacted our experience significantly. If they needed more time, they could have communicated that instead of leaving us in the dark.Banquet Management
Dave, the banquet manager, was professional and patient, but Eddie, the director, was rude and unprofessional. Eddie shouted at staff before the banquet over space issues. The vendor stylist had requested a two-meter aisle, but Eddie failed to account for the extra space needed for chairs. He initially refused to adjust (requested by the vendor and banquet manager) until I stepped in to justify, and even then, his hostility and poor attitude reflected badly on the hotel. Such behavior is unacceptable for someone in a leadership position.When I raised the issue, Eddie initially refused to adjust and only complied after I intervened. However, his attitude remained hostile, and he vented his frustration on the staff, creating an unprofessional and tense atmosphere. Such behavior is appalling for someone in a leadership role, and I strongly recommend Eddie be placed on a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) to address his attitude, communication, and ability to manage situations effectively.Bridal Suite Stay
The bridal suite was disappointing. One power outlet in the bedroom was not working, leaving us reliant on a single outlet near the bed. The living room had only one set of outlets located in the corner of the table—insufficient for a suite of this size. Additionally, the outlets were unstable, frequently turning on and off, making it difficult to charge devices reliably.I strongly recommend future couples bring several portable chargers and ensure they are fully charged beforehand, as it is nearly impossible to use devices comfortably while charging in the bridal suite. Adding to the disappointment, the suite lacked a bidet, which is a basic amenity and should be standard in a five-star hotel.Massage Experience
The massage at Essence Vale was poor. The masseuse, Sue, repeatedly caused discomfort by massaging my bones despite my feedback. When I raised concerns, she laughed and dismissed them. The spa is severely understaffed, with only two masseuses, neither of whom seemed properly trained to provide a professional experience.I ended the session early out of frustration and received only a 10% discount as compensation. The dismissive attitude from the staff made the experience worse. If you’re seeking a real massage, I strongly recommend visiting a real massage parlor rather than this hotel spa.Overall
While Dave was a bright spot, the unprofessional behavior of Eddie, poor communication from coordinators, subpar bridal suite amenities, and disappointing spa experience made this far below expectations for a five-star hotel. This caused our whole schedule of the dinner to be very stressed and rushed, because we had a few performances and speeches lined up during the night. We also rushed our table photo-taking to order to try to finish early. At 10.30pm, we were done taking pictures, but the guests were still sitting around and enjoying their time together. However, by this time Desmond was standing around and giving us very angry glares to make us try to leave as soon as possible. He even told my friends to ask the guests to leave. This whole experience was really upsetting and unpleasant because both my husband and I are living in the US, and we do not get a lot of time to spend with our family and friends in Singapore. Bread rolls ran out and there was not enough for all the guests, the number of which had clearly been communicated to the restaurant beforehand. When asked about it, the general manager argued loudly that he would only follow his serving schedule to put the cake knife and set up for the champagne popping when the main course was served. The main course had already been served to most tables at that point, but he still argued loudly with the emcee in front of the wedding guests which created an embarrassing and uncomfortable situation.
Thirdly, throughout the event, the air-conditioning in the restaurant was malfunctioning. It was unbearably hot inside the restaurant during the banquet, and to make matters worse, the general manager had the staff switch off the air-conditioning towards the end of the event to force us leave quickly. He even harshly snapped at the bride "Your event is over, you have to leave" when she was taking a last few photos with guests and family. Throughout the event, staff would also report to work by walking through the main aisle of the restaurant without regard for what was occurring.

It resulted in the wedding cake and the couple on stage with no knife and no champagne tower! Worse still, the GM could tell me off that he hadn't finish serving the main meals. For a restaurant of this price point, the service was a big fail.
I had dined at Monti a on a few occasions but today's wedding experience was terrible. I felt sorry for the guests and sorry for the couple. Capacity: 250 paxEvent HallMalayGrand Dahlia★★★★★ 4.76 (92 reviews)Event HallMalayBack to Venues Page3 couple reviewsVenue: 5 ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️Service: 5 ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️Food: 5 ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️2 guest reviewsVenue: 3.5 ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️Service: 2 ⭐️ ⭐️Food: 3.5 ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️All ReviewsCoupleGuest​​Daniel Ng (Couple)Venue: 5Service: 5Food: 5Due to a hiccup at our original banquet venue, my wife and I were scrambling to find a new banquet venue 1.5 months before our wedding day (19 Nov 2022). A friend of ours referred us to Ruel (the manager at NSRCC Fu Lin Men) and from the first moment we spoke to him until the end, he has been nothing but flexible, professional, and helpful in our dire time of need.He was prompt in responding to our queries over WhatsApp, and expedited a lot of necessary preparations because of the short timeline. Throughout this intense period of preparation, Ruel always made sure that we were at ease and assured. On the actual day, he was on the ball in working with us and our coordinator in giving us updates to make sure everything was running on schedule.Beyond the great atmosphere, very reasonable pricing, spacious venue and delicious food, it was Ruel's professionalism and his heart to help us as best as he could that makes this 5-star review an understatement of how good a place NSRCC Fu Lin Men was to us.FromGoogle Maps· Apr 2023Ariel Foo (Couple)Venue: 5Service: 5Food: 5Just had our wedding lunch at Fu Lin Men, NSRCC. Would like to express our greatest gratitude to restaurant manager, Ruel and his team. He has been very responsible and professional in following up with the necessary preparation for the banquet. He had even free up his time to go through the whole programme flow with us personally before our wedding. We felt relieved with his help and his professionalism. Fantastic service and would definitely recommend! The venue is pretty, well decorated and quite spacious. The food was great and portions are big, our guests enjoyed!FromGoogle Maps· Dec 2022Low J.W (Couple)Venue: 5Service: 5Food: 5Thank you to Mr Ruel, from the Low FamilyOur first visit to NSRCC Fu Lin Men was on the August 2022, we were warmly welcomed by Mr Ruel. We wanted to enquire on the ROM Solemnization lunch package that they offered.Even though the restaurant was quite busy during lunch hour, Mr Ruel still entertained us and patiently explained the myriad of dishes that they offered, the service and packages that are included and helped assure us that he'll do whatever he could in his capacity to make this the best wedding we would have while still staying in budget. Mr Ruel offered us packages that best fitted within our budget as well as alternative dishes and special requested that we had.We were then offered a discounted taste test 2 week later where my family enjoyed the scrumptious meal prepared by Mr Ruel and the team. Throughout the taste testing, we were able to give our opinions and changes on the dishes served. We thoroughly enjoyed our time there taste testing my dishes, and even dishes that are not available on the menu itself.A few weeks later, we also had requested Halal, Vegan and Vegeterian menu. Mr Ruel and his team managed to help us with it while many restaurant had turned us away. I'm amazed by the service and afterthought that Mr Ruel and team had provided.The arrangement of seatings and function room was amazing  Mr Ruel and his team helped make the room look extremely well done and fitted our theme, yet we didn't even fork out a single cent for it. Seats were arranged by what I've planned and meal dietary restriction are marked by the color of handkerchief, amazing way to make it subtle. Mr Ruel also provided tips and tricks on how we could better improve the layout while also keeping in kind my requirement. Mr Ruel also came down on his off day upon my request to finalise the plan a day before the wedding. Such commitment towards customer is really commendable and I could see why Mr Ruel and his team has such high rating over many sites.On the wedding day itself, everyone enjoyed themselves and praised the food many of my guest even said they would come back to the restaurant because the meal were perfect. Mr Ruel came numerous time to the function room to make sure everything was going smoothly and that the guest was happy. Mr Ruel even went out of his way to help me MCee the event when our MCee could not turn up as she was sick. We ended our day with a happy note.Thank you Mr Ruel and the team. We appreciate and thank you for making our wedding day the best day of our life.Low FamilyFromGoogle Maps· Oct 2022Jo Lin (Guest)Venue: 2Service: 2Food: 3Came here to attend a wedding.

Drinks ordered was served wrongly to the next table.Would not choose to come again.FromGoogle Maps· Dec 2021Chamz Zheng (Guest)Venue: 5Food: 4Attended wedding there. The building itself is impressive, and the lobby is beautifully decorated, with a trendy, modern aesthetic. Check-in was smooth, and the staff was friendly and professional.However, as Marriott Bonvoy Titanium members, we were initially assigned a low-level room, which was a bit disappointing. Given that it was Chinese New Year, we understood the high occupancy, but the room was so small that we couldn’t even open our luggage properly.We were then upgraded but had to wait until 7 PM to access the new room, which was only about 3 feet wider. While this was a bit frustrating, we quickly realized that room sizes in this hotel are much smaller than typical JW Marriott properties in Southeast Asia. Having stayed at JW locations in Hong Kong, Bangkok, and Kuala Lumpur recently, this felt like a significant contrast, but we assume this is due to Singapore’s premium real estate constraints.Room & Decor
The room itself was comfortable but compact. The decor felt more like a trendy W Hotel rather than the classic, sophisticated JW Marriott style. While this may appeal to some, we expected a more refined, business-style ambiance in line with other JW properties.

❌ Seating was limited and not as comfortable as other JW lounges, possibly due to the high traffic and a setup that encourages guests to come and go.
✨ Special mention to Jolene, who was amazing and went above and beyond to make guests feel welcome!Breakfast – Great Selection but Chaotic

✅ Extensive food selection, with plenty of fresh options.

The room is spacious and very well designed. It is worth paying the amount for a short period of stay. Room service and banquet service is perfect, thou dinner usually served by part timer here… but they are well organised and all looks very experienced. Food and wine offered are perfect matched. Design theme of the Ballroom is unique, romantic and believe guests are having a very pleasent event. Location is so easy to access. Just a 2-3 mins walk from promenade mrt station with near by Marina Square shopping Mall and sundeck city. A few stations to heart of the island, Chinatown and shopping belt Orchard Road.FromGoogle Maps· Jul 2023Richard Tan (Guest)Venue: 5Service: 5Food: 5Went there to take a look at the ballroom for someone's wedding dinner. The ballroom and the reception area are really posh and spacious with super high ceiling and state of the art video screens.Food wise, could opt for 1 star Michelin menu.Public transport is good with MRT station nearby for guests who do not drive.Nice of the banquet staff to serve us their wonderful coffee and Madeline.UPDATEJust had my daughter's wedding dinner held at the ballroom. It was attended by more than 300 guests. All guests commented that the food was excellent. The customer service was wonderful.When I had to go up or down the stage, a staff would be at the steps to hold my hand. I am 68 years old.When I was standing at the door to thank guests, a staff came up to offer me a glass of water. She observed that I had to speak to so many people and would require some refreshment.FURTHER COMMENTThe staff went that extra mile, taking their own initiative to delight customers. They went beyond my family and my daughter's wedding guests expectation.MORE UPDATESAttended a DBS event here last night. Don't know why we couldn't get wine served at our table while all tables around us were served. Finally, when a staff came over, she only had enough wine to serve 4 out of 8 persons. She went to get more but took a super long time to come back.FromGoogle Maps· Jan 2023Joo Goh (Guest)Service: 5Food: 5Was there for a wedding lunch and was surprised at the quality of the sound and video system, spectacular, was the only word to describe the experience.

Told the wife that this is the place for our next grand function.FromGoogle Maps· Dec 2022Adam Wu (Guest)Service: 1Food: 3Attended my cousin's wedding at the grandball room. The so-called butler service of St. Regis, I didn't see the figure of this "butler" from beginning to end during my three-day stay. I don't know what my butler is called. The black tea brewed with tea bags provided by the butler has to be paid after noon. If this service is the standard of St. Regis, it is too embarrassing for Marriott.
I set the preference of Marriott Bonvoy APP to a high floor, but the room we got was a low floor. We are Titanium members of Marriott Group. My family lives in the most basic room. The child wants to take a nap for an hour because of airsickness. The hotel does not allow delayed check-out until 1 pm, even though the rooms around are vacant. It is recommended that the management of this hotel go to St. Regis Changsha, China and St. Regis New York, USA to learn how to provide good butler service and how to develop a proactive service mindset. Your so-called "butler" is not as enthusiastic and professional as the doormen in the concierge!FromGoogle Maps· Feb 2025Cheng Tong (Couple)Service: 5We had the best possible experience hosting family and friends for our wedding at St Regis. Sharon was the nicest and most approachable venue coordinator/events manager that we could ever asked for. She was always patient, polite and thoughtful throughout the entire 1 year process of planning it and we cant thank her enough. On the day of the wedding itself, Nuri who was the bride's butler, was very attentive and proactive in catering to our needs and Ken, as our banquet manager ensured that the event could run as smoothly as possible so we didnt have to worry about anything. We would highly recommend st regis, singapore to everyone.FromGoogle Maps· Feb 2025Brian (Couple)Venue: 5Service: 5Food: 5Hello all, just had my wedding few weeks back and these are the vendors we engaged. During covid, we continued the tradition by ordering their special delivery menu.Today however, we are heartbroken the signature dishes has deteriorated beyond belief with exception of the templated cold dishes.Our top favourite of all time, the spicy fried chicken 辣子鸡丁cubes did not contain much chicken but more spicy flour puffs and the once special aroma is missing. Those who have dined here long enough will know.Next, the signature fine beans 干煸四季豆 were an absolute disappointment. It’s really disappointing but frankly we felt the recook was not done with effort. $148-$168++/paxEvent HallRestaurantChineseFusionWesternAll ReviewsCoupleGuest​​loh (Couple)Venue: 5Service: 5Food: 5Held my wedding here for 50guests here and had a wonderful time.Venue:
Gorgeous environment with beautiful sunlight during the day. The venue did make clear to us before we signed the contract that the place is only accessible via stairs to the 2nd floor, and is not wheelchair-friendly. They do have suggestions for alternative solutions for wheelchairs which we chose to not engage, but it was entirely our choice to accept it or not. The bridal room was spacious and gorgeous. Place is clean and aircon was good.Food:
Everything was delicious. I loved the Angel hair pasta and many of my guests praised the herbal chicken soup. Champagne and white wine was amazing as well.Service:
The entire process from booking, planning, to the actual day required many details, but the planner from the venue guided me through it all while answering all my questions. Response was fast and concise, making the whole process stress-free.
Actual day service by the ground staff was also impressive. Many guests commented that their drinks were refilled swiftly and I personally received so much help for minor details I’ve missed out.
I felt their dedication and sincerity to making sure my special day ran smoothly.Price:
The packages offered are reasonably priced with many inclusions that surprised me. As far as intimate weddings go, the venue and people went above and beyond what I expected in price, quality and service.Overall, my now husband and I fell in love and will continue to love this place as the perfect spot that hosted our wedding. We are grateful to everyone at the venue for their efforts and graciousness. Highly recommend!FromGoogle Maps· Jun 2024Elna Tan (Guest)Venue: 4Gorgeous venue, a smaller alternative to the hall. So beautiful, the lack of lift does not deter the choice of this setting brightly lited for a lunch wedding. Though, the toilet situation can be better managed.FromGoogle Maps· Jun 2024Yingzhi Tan (Guest)Venue: 3Attended a wedding for 120 pax at the Alcove. Have to take the wooden stairs (accessible from the corridor where you see a spiral staircase at the end) up to L2. (Bummer for the ppl who carried the coffee machine up.) Cozy intimate setting but 4 columns in the space block the sight lines of some guests. Pity that.FromGoogle Maps· Nov 2023Y S (Guest)Venue: 4Great place for a wedding banquet. Good lighting. But the projector need to be upgraded. Not so bright.FromGoogle Maps· Sep 2023Cristina Ng (Guest)Venue: 2Service: 5Food: 4Attended a wedding here, to summarise my experience, it was a good one but with a few exceptions.Venue: Is perfect for a small intimate wedding up to 100 pax. Place is bright and well air conditioned. But do bear in mind the venue is at level 2 and only can be access through the stairwell. There is no elevator hence is very unfriendly for elderlies.Amenities: Toilet is so so soooo bad and smelly. It was not well maintained by the cleaners, it is a sharing toilet with 2 cubicles. The odour was so bad I have to refrain myself from drinking too much and hold my bladder to release at the mall after the wedding.Food: The best of all weddings I’ve attended. Everything was delicious except for the angel hair pasta (too dry).Services: Very fast and responsive.Everything is good experience except the toilet. Hence 3/5 stars. Otherwise it could be a 5/5.FromGoogle Maps· Jun 2023Patrick Lau (Guest)Venue: 3Food: 3Was here for a wedding lunch reception.  Food catered to was ok, appear’s to be by Pauls.  Drinks wise atypical wedding reception drinks.Now, about the place.  Personally I feel that this place is neither kids nor elderly/handicap friendly.  There’s no lift to the place and after the main glass entrance, there are at least two stumbling blocks at 2 wooden door frames which is not that visible to kids/elderly/handicapped.  The air conditioner were underwhelming and were later tuned cooler after we gave feedback during the proceedingsSpace is pretty limited and if you want to run a cozy event, it may fit well.
